d: Rize is a groundbreaking rent-now-pay-later platform reshaping the rental landscape in Saudi Arabia. We're dedicated to making rentals more accessible and affordable, enabling tenants to manage their finances with ease and landlords to secure their income effortlessly. We're on a mission to revolutionize the rental industry, breaking down barriers and creating opportunities for all. We're a team of innovators, thinkers, and problem-solvers, committed to creating a positive impact and driving change in the market.

We love working together, being creative, and doing things differently! Our team is made up of people with different nationalities. We work from a cozy office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. And hey, we're not just smart, we're really good at coming up with new ideas.
Innovation – We’re a technology-driven team with the purpose of uplifting the real estate sector. We are the leaders of the industry in innovation.
Customer Centricity – We put the customer at the core of every decision and action.
Adaptability - Being able to adapt quickly to changing market conditions and customer needs.
Empowerment & Collaboration – Our team is the most valuable aspect of the company; We respect all ideas, our team enjoys authority, autonomy, and collaboration.
Ethical Excellence - We perform within the highest ethical standard.

You will build a single Operations department that owns everything after the sale: checking, contracting, paying the landlord, collecting, serving and renewing. Your mission is to build the engine that carries Rize to several times today’s volume, with faster turnaround, higher accuracy and less manual work.
q: 10+ years in operations, including 4+ years leading multi-unit operations at a consumer finance company, BNPL player, fintech lender, bank retail operations or high-volume marketplace.
Experience running processing, collections and customer service at volume, and taking an operation through several times growth.
Track record of process redesign and automation with product and tech teams, with measurable results on cycle time, cost and quality.
Comfort with lender, auditor and regulator expectations: controls, separation of duties, service levels, case documentation.
Experience managing managers and building team-lead layers and career ladders.
Strong advantage: knowledge of Saudi rental and government platforms (Ejar, Najiz, the real estate registry).
r: li

Bring Credit Operations, Contracting and Fulfilment, Collections and Payments, and Customer Experience and Renewals under one structure with clear roles, service levels and handovers to Risk, Sales and Finance.
